mobchampions.configuration.spawning.desc:
Relative weights determine the chance of each rank spawning.
Default weights are set so there is a 50% chance for common mobs,
27.5% chance for uncommon champions, 16.5% chance for rare champions,
5% chance for epic champions, and 1% chance for legendary champions.
mobchampions.configuration.spawning.name: Champion Spawning Settings
mobchampions.configuration.spawntypeblac:
Blacklist of spawn types that prevent champions from spawning.
Spawn types must be one of: [NATURAL, CHUNK_GENERATION, SPAWNER, STRUCTURE, BREEDING, MOB_SUMMONED, JOCKEY, EVENT, CONVERSION, REINFORCEMENT, TRIGGERED, BUCKET, SPAWN_EGG, COMMAND, DISPENSER, PATROL, TRIAL_SPAWNER]
mobchampions.configuration.standardarmor: Chance for champions wearing standard armor to drop it on death.
mobchampions.configuration.standardweapo: Chance for champions wielding standard weapons to drop them on death.
